site_name: Development Site Between 43 And 45 Clarence Avenue And Rear Of Montrose House 412 To 416
description: Non-material amendment to approved permission 4462/20 (as changed by Non-material Amendment application 4462/20/01 and Variation of Condition application 2108/25): change of the description of the development to 'Retention of Montrose House. Erection of two buildings to provide up to 1252.7sqm of education/commercial floorspace and 15no. residential units with private amenity space, children's play space, communal amenity space, cycle parking, accessible parking, waste storage facilities, hard and soft landscaping and associated works'. (Summary).
decision_conditions:
Block A as shown on plan 479-B-01 Rev F of approved permission Ref: 4462/20 shall have a maximum height of 25.55 METRES (including lift returns and related rooftop equipment) when measured from ground level at the front of the site on Eastern Avenue. 

Block B as shown on plan 479-B-01 Rev F of approved permission Ref: 4462/20 shall have a maximum height of 15.95 METRES (including lift returns and related rooftop equipment) when measured from the lowest ground level at the front of the building on Clarence Avenue. 

Reason: To maintain an appropriate height in relation to neighbouring buildings and to comply with Policies LP26 of the Redbridge Local Plan and D3 of the London Plan.
